name: Chamber of Reverberation
text:
Instant and sorcery spells you cast have replicate {1}. (When you cast such a spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
Instant and sorcery spells you cast from your hand have rebound. (As those spells resolve, exile them instead of putting them into your graveyard. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast those cards from exile without paying their mana costs.)
